title: Fix possible MPI deadlock in MD
body:
Fix bug where we forgot to pass communicator to logger, which might cause a deadlock or bad IO depending on how things run.

While we don't currently have infrastructure to test this in ASE CI, I found the bug using GPAW's test suite where we are adding a deadlock safety system.
